{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS170 |prevtitle=The Last Battle IV |nextcode=PS172 |nexttitle=The Last Battle VI |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Last Battle V |title_ja=最終決戦V |title_ro=The Last Battle V |image=PS171.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 171 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 171 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |location=[[Indigo Plateau]] }} '''The Last Battle V''' (Japanese: '''最終決戦V''' ''The Last Battle V'') is the 171st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 81st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} After {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}} forms its crystal wall to aid [[Misty]], the [[Masked Man]] is cut in half. Despite this, the Masked Man's upper body emerges from the wall. He attacks [[Lt. Surge]], and {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Entei}} retaliates by shooting fire into the Masked Man. A large hole is torn into his abdomen from the attack, but he continues to move. Misty commands Suicune to protect the others, but it stumbles and collapses. The Masked Man reveals that he had his {{p|Gastly}} use {{m|Curse}} on Suicune, and if Suicune is trapped within its own wall, there is no escape. {{adv|Crystal}} arrives just in time as Misty begins to lose consciousness. Through Suicune's wall, Crystal sees a hand holding a [[Clear Bell]] and realizes that [[Eusine]] is inside. The Clear Bell begins to dissolve the crystal wall, and Eusine has his {{p|Electrode}} carry Misty and Suicune out to safety. Seeking Eusine's help for {{adv|Gold}}, Crystal goes back to where he was knocked down, but finds that he has disappeared. Nearby, [[Falkner]], [[Bugsy]], [[Whitney]], and [[Morty]] find the [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman, who informs them of the Masked Man's apparent invincibility. When he explains that the Masked Man was unaffected by being torn in two and having a hole bored into his stomach, Whitney becomes tense. She begins to shudder as she realizes she knows the identity of the Masked Man. The Masked Man flies away with {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}}, {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}}, and his {{p|Delibird}}, unaware that Gold is pursuing him from below. Tears can be seen streaming from the Masked Man's mask as he mentions how he will finally be able to see his "La Prus" and "La Pris" again. ==Major events== * [[Misty]] battles the [[Masked Man]]. * [[Eusine]] saves Misty and {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}}. * {{adv|Gold}} follows the Masked Man. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Crystal}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Misty]] * [[Lt.
